name: ephemeral-k8s-test-envs
description: Per-pull-request ephemeral test environments on Kubernetes.
author: AKogut

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app/auth-service install && npm --prefix app/notes-service install && npm --prefix app/gateway install
scripts.build: npm --prefix app/auth-service run build && npm --prefix app/notes-service run build && npm --prefix app/gateway run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app/auth-service run typecheck && npm --prefix app/notes-service run typecheck && npm --prefix app/gateway run typecheck
